eligibility: Exact registered model with complete canonical Standard reference prices crossed with adapter-supported efforts, intersected with current frozen application discovery and the explicit execution allowlist. Actual offered efforts come from the frozen application; dated official effort documentation is supplied as context and a discrepancy is not an availability veto. No alias, high-only restriction or automatic fallback.
effort_authority: Actual offered efforts are verified by frozen application model/list. Canonical pricing capability documentation can lag that list; retain both sources and label differences. Selection and CLI arguments verify requested effort only; actual internal effective effort remains unknown.
question: Which one eligible model and reasoning-effort profile should execute this exact implementation or repair task? Apply state.instructions to the current task, original requirements, write scope, public failure signals, canonical capabilities and prices, and empirical_evidence. Optimize verified full completion including repair calls, time and tokens rather than initial call cost. Choose unknown if no supported selection can be made.
instructions: Choose one listed model-and-effort profile for the exact current task. All listed efforts are legal; effort is not fixed at high. Optimize successful verified full completion and total development time, tokens and reference cost including unsuccessful/no-op repairs and later recalls, not merely the price of the first call. Compare original interfaces, writable scope, implementation versus repair, public failure signals, official capabilities and prices, and the empirical_evidence supplied inline. Use public success denominators, failed/unknown outcomes, no-op counts, subsequent repairs, measured time and cache-inclusive tokens. Distinguish exact-task/phase evidence from broader aggregates and account for task/environment differences. Scarce or absent observations remain unknown; do not invent success rates, set arbitrary pass-rate thresholds, treat small samples as guarantees, or assume an unobserved profile is worse. Do not infer parameter counts, actual subscription bills, measured speed or served model identity from model names or API prices. Controller hashes and file paths are provenance, not retrievable content. Failure-signal projection omissions do not certify correctness. Choose only a supplied profile ID, or unknown. Never modify task ownership, scope, tests or completion gates. Do not write code, pick a model outside the candidates, retry, or substitute another profile after selection.
unknown: No eligible model-and-effort selection is supported by the task, verified availability, canonical capability/price data and empirical evidence. Stop without a fallback.
inline_resolution: Each candidate.model resolves the exact model record in state.models. Official capabilities, discovery and prices occur there once per model. empirical_evidence.statistics contains complete inline statistic objects; each profile's global_ref, exact_scope_ref and requirement_overlap_ref names one of those inline rows. Resolve these local references before comparing denominators. These are lossless inline references, not controller files or retrieval tools.
history_boundary: Public observations joined to worker receipts and artifact revisions only. Independent/hidden grading is excluded. Rates are observations with explicit denominators, not calibration or performance guarantees.
boundary: A new model-and-effort selection condition, separate from fixed-worker comparisons and v1 high-only selection. No parameter-count claim, permission expansion, automatic retry, hidden-test training, served-identity claim or completion approval.
